name: snapstudio
description: Let Claude design on your Mac: App Store screenshots, social posts and carousels, templates, upscaling and background removal, all rendered locally by SnapStudio.
long_description: SnapStudio is a native macOS design studio with a built-in MCP server. With this extension Claude can fill templates with your copy and brand kit, beautify screenshots, export every App Store and social size, render carousels and short MP4s, upscale (RealESRGAN) and cut out backgrounds on-device, and find and redact API keys or faces before you share a screenshot. Requires SnapStudio 1.0 or later, installed from getsnapstudio.com or the Mac App Store; this extension starts the server bundled inside the app.

workspace.title: Workspace folder
workspace.description: Where SnapStudio saves the documents and exports Claude makes. It can read images from anywhere but only writes here.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List .snapstudio documents in the workspace with canvas size, layer count, and modification date.

tools.name: duplicate_document
tools.description: Copy an EXISTING document (layers AND image assets) to a new name — the safe way to branch a variant before editing.

tools.name: duplicate_layer
tools.description: Duplicate a layer (groups duplicate their whole subtree) with fresh ids, inserted just above the original.

tools.name: list_fonts
tools.description: List font families available for text layers (installed + app-bundled).

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a new empty document.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List design templates (id, name, category, size) with their fillable slots (text/image, keyed by slot name).

tools.name: list_palettes
tools.description: List the shared color palettes (id, name, family, role colors) — built-ins plus saved brand palettes.

tools.name: save_palette
tools.description: Save a brand palette (edit-and-save-new): start from based_on (any palette) and override any role colors, or specify all roles.

tools.name: delete_palette
tools.description: Delete a saved user palette (built-ins can't be deleted).

tools.name: list_brand_kits
tools.description: List saved brand kits (colors, fonts, logo, URL).

tools.name: save_brand_kit
tools.description: Save a brand kit: colors (from an existing palette or inline), heading/body fonts, URL/handle, and a logo image.

tools.name: apply_brand_kit
tools.description: Apply a brand kit to a document: recolor the background + text (heuristic role mapping), set brand fonts, and place the logo.

tools.name: generate_social_asset
tools.description: ONE CALL from brief to branded asset: template + brand kit + slot content → filled, branded document; optionally export sizes in the same call (preset or variants).

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: Search the reusable asset library (logos, icons, textures) by name or tag.

tools.name: save_asset
tools.description: Save a reusable image (or an AUDIO music bed via audio_path) to the asset library with a name and tags.

tools.name: add_asset_to_document
tools.description: Place a library asset (by id from list_assets) into a document as an image layer.

tools.name: create_from_template
tools.description: Create a document from a template with its designed placeholder content.

tools.name: fill_template
tools.description: Create a document from a template with slot content applied in one call: texts maps slot name to replacement copy (typography stays as designed; copy longer than the slot box auto-shrinks the font unl

tools.name: render_template_batch
tools.description: Render one PNG per fill from a single template — batch asset generation.

tools.name: relayout_template
tools.description: RE-LAYOUT one template into other formats — the smart alternative to cropping.

tools.name: article_to_formats
tools.description: ARTICLE → CAROUSEL in one call: reads a URL (or html/title+points you supply), plans cover → key points → CTA, re-lays the template out for every requested format, and renders numbered slides into <ou

tools.name: generate_marketing_set
tools.description: Beautify a screenshot (gradient background, rounded corners) and export it in curated social-media sizes (Instagram square/story/portrait, Facebook, X, YouTube, LinkedIn) as PNGs into output_dir.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get the document's canvas + full layer tree (ids, names, types, frames) — the agent's DOM.

tools.name: add_image_layer
tools.description: Add an image layer from a file path (readable anywhere) or base64 data.

tools.name: add_text_layer
tools.description: Add a text layer.

tools.name: measure_text
tools.description: Measure whether text fits a frame BEFORE creating a layer: returns fits true/false, the rendered size, and (when it overflows) the largest font size that fits.

tools.name: add_shape_layer
tools.description: Add a shape layer.

tools.name: set_layer_transform
tools.description: Move/resize/rotate a layer (any omitted field keeps its value).

tools.name: reorder_layer
tools.description: Change a layer's stacking order among its siblings (layers render bottom→top).

tools.name: add_pattern_layer
tools.description: Add a procedural background pattern (grid, dots, diagonal stripes, waves) as an image layer — no external tooling needed.

tools.name: add_mesh_background
tools.description: Add a macOS-wallpaper-style multi-color mesh background (colors anchored around corners, softly blended) as a bottom image layer.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List reusable design components (CTA button, slide badge, URL footer, category header, separator, photo overlay, slide counter, stat card, logo lockup) with their text slots — drop them into a documen

tools.name: add_component
tools.description: Insert a reusable component into a document as one group layer, painted from a palette or brand kit so it lands on-brand.

tools.name: lint_design
tools.description: Design QA: flags text overflow, layers mostly off-canvas, empty image slots, low text/background contrast, overlapping text layers (collisions), and text/logo outside the format's safe area (Reels/Sho

tools.name: score_design
tools.description: Design quality score 0–100 with sub-scores (readability, text density, contrast, safe area) — gate export on quality.

tools.name: render_contact_sheet
tools.description: Render up to 20 documents and/or image files side by side in one labeled grid image — review a whole carousel (Instagram allows 20 slides) at a glance, or compare PNGs already on disk without leaving

tools.name: set_layer_props
tools.description: Edit a layer in place — the one call for everything about an existing layer.

tools.name: remove_layer
tools.description: Remove a layer.

tools.name: render_preview
tools.description: Render the composited canvas as a PNG image — LOOK at your work after editing.

tools.name: export_image
tools.description: Export the composited document to a file in the workspace (png/jpeg/webp/heic/tiff/gif/bmp/pdf).

tools.name: open_in_app
tools.description: Open the document in the SnapStudio app for the human to see.

tools.name: set_adjustments
tools.description: Set photo adjustments on an image layer (only provided fields change; 0 = neutral).

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: List the built-in filter presets (id, name, category).

tools.name: apply_filter
tools.description: Apply a filter preset to an image layer (replaces its adjustments).

tools.name: crop_layer
tools.description: Crop an image layer to a rect in IMAGE PIXELS, TOP-LEFT origin, y down — the same convention detect_sensitive_data reports and redact_layer's `regions` expects, so a rectangle from either can be passe

tools.name: set_canvas_size
tools.description: Change the canvas size; layers keep their pixel positions relative to the chosen anchor.

tools.name: upscale_layer
tools.description: AI-upscale an image layer's pixels with RealESRGAN (2x or 4x).

tools.name: remove_background
tools.description: Remove the background of an image layer (Vision subject mask).

tools.name: detect_sensitive_data
tools.description: Scan an image layer — or every image layer in the document, if layer_id is omitted — for e-mails, API keys, card numbers, IBANs, phone numbers, IP addresses, tokenised URLs, home paths and faces.

tools.name: redact_layer
tools.description: Permanently paint over (black out, pixelate, or blur) regions of an image layer — the sensitive-data eraser for screenshots.

tools.name: auto_enhance
tools.description: One-click intelligent enhance of an image layer (histogram analysis; replaces pixels).

tools.name: set_hsl
tools.description: Per-color-band HSL grading on an image layer.

tools.name: set_tone_curve
tools.description: Set a tone curve on an image layer (2-5 control points, 0-1 space).

tools.name: list_stickers
tools.description: List built-in vector stickers.

tools.name: add_sticker
tools.description: Add a vector sticker as a shape layer.

tools.name: list_frames
tools.description: List photo frame styles.

tools.name: apply_frame
tools.description: Bake a photo frame around an image layer's pixels.

tools.name: list_mockups
tools.description: List device mockup frames (Mac, iPhone, iPad, browser, watch).

tools.name: apply_mockup
tools.description: Frame a TOP-LEVEL image layer inside a device mockup.

tools.name: list_beautify_styles
tools.description: List screenshot beautifier styles.

tools.name: beautify_layer
tools.description: Screenshot beautifier: gradient backdrop, padding, rounded corners and shadow around a TOP-LEVEL image layer.

tools.name: list_collage_templates
tools.description: List collage layouts.

tools.name: create_collage
tools.description: Create a collage document from image files (one per slot, in order).

tools.name: save_as_template
tools.description: Save the document's layer structure as a reusable user template (appears in the app's gallery too).

tools.name: delete_template
tools.description: Permanently delete ONE user template by its exact id (use list_templates or inspect_template to find it — a name is not accepted here because a name can match several templates, and a delete must neve

tools.name: preview_template
tools.description: Render a template's preview image (built-in or user; embedded logos/photos included, empty image slots shown as gray placeholders) — LOOK at a template before choosing it.

tools.name: generate_aso_pack
tools.description: COMPLETE store listings in one call: renders the built-in aso_* families (hero, features, CTA) with your app screenshots and copy for every language x platform — iPhone, iPad, Google Play AND the Mac

tools.name: inspect_template
tools.description: Structured JSON for one template: canvas, slots (name/role/default), full layer tree with frames/fonts/kinds, folder/family, palette-swappability — the machine-readable alternative to list_templates p

tools.name: diagnostics
tools.description: Server healthcheck / restart status: an ok line, the git commit this binary was built from (and whether the working tree was dirty at build time), whether a NEWER build has since been deployed to bin/

tools.name: render_carousel
tools.description: One-call social carousel (Instagram max 20 slides; YouTube Shorts max 10; sizes per platform: 1080x1080, 1080x1920, 960x1200, 1080x1350).

tools.name: save_video_template
tools.description: Save a reusable VIDEO template (CapCut-style): scenes reference layer templates (with slots) plus per-layer animations, holds, transition and preset.

tools.name: list_video_templates
tools.description: List saved video templates with their scenes, layer templates, and fillable slots.

tools.name: render_video_template
tools.description: Render a saved video template into a finished MP4: per-scene slot fills (texts/image_paths like fill_template, plus clip_paths for VIDEO in image slots), optional palette/music/bpm override.

tools.name: delete_video_template
tools.description: Delete a saved video template by id or name.

tools.name: export_animated_post
tools.description: Animated social MP4 where each document's LAYERS animate in (slide/fade/pop, staggered bottom-to-top), hold fully visible, then cut/crossfade to the next document — motion-design posts straight from d

tools.name: export_slideshow
tools.description: Turn images or documents into a social MP4 slideshow (30 fps): per-slide duration, hard-cut or crossfade, optional Ken Burns pan-zoom and background music.

tools.name: export_templates
tools.description: Export user templates to a portable directory (one sidecar bundle per template, image assets included) for backup or moving to another machine — re-importable with import_templates.

tools.name: import_templates
tools.description: Import templates from a directory made by export_templates (or a copy of another machine's Templates dir).

tools.name: export_platform_pack
tools.description: Export the composited document at every size in a platform pack (App Store screenshots, Google Play incl.

tools.name: set_layer_mask
tools.description: Mask a layer to a rectangle or ellipse region (layer-local coordinates, top-down).

tools.name: clear_layer_mask
tools.description: Remove a layer's mask.

tools.name: add_drawing_layer
tools.description: Add a freehand drawing layer from polyline strokes (layer-local, top-down).

tools.name: clone_heal
tools.description: Clone or heal along a path on an image layer (image-pixel coordinates, top-down).

tools.name: apply_perspective
tools.description: Warp (apply) or de-keystone (correct) an image layer's pixels by four corners (image pixels, top-down).

tools.name: import_svg
tools.description: Import an SVG file as a vector layer group (optionally placed into a frame).

tools.name: export_svg
tools.description: Export the document as SVG (vector layers stay vector; trace_images vectorizes photos).

tools.name: batch_process
tools.description: Run one operation over every image in a folder (max 500).
